text: Add impression-time request context (tab, hour, weekday) to the additive user/video-ID scorer.
rationale: This is the only feature family with a positive, directionally consistent train-only temporal-screen lift: +0.00221 primary across all four reported days and full coverage. It is therefore the highest-information first official ablation.
exact_ablation: Extend the seed feature encoder with train-fitted categorical fields tab, hour derived from hourmin, and weekday derived from date; retain the additive model, BCE loss, optimizer, and all other settings unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase by approximately 0.001 to 0.004 because context can alter video ordering within a user.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase by approximately 0.000 to 0.003; the screen supports broad ranking lift more strongly than top-five lift.
